Subject: RE: Selwyn Plaza LLC - Quote Request

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the submission on Selwyn Plaza LLC! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward with quoting.

I have a few questions before I can finalize pricing:

- Can you provide additional details on the occupancy types at each of the three locations?
- Are there any fire protection systems (sprinklers, alarms) in place at the properties?
- What are the construction types and year built for each building?
- Any planned renovations or improvements in the next 12 months?

Once I have these details, I'll work up competitive terms for the December 2026 effective date.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
